title: Uwell Viscore Neo 6K Prefilled Pod & Refill Milky Strawberry
description: Ensure your Viscore Neo is fully topped up with Milky Strawberry 6K Prefilled Pod & Refill Pack, tailored specifically for the Uwell Viscore Neo kit. This practical replacement pack connects a 2ml prefilled pod to a 4ml auto-refill container, providing a total of 6ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid. Designed for continuous use, the auto-refill system keeps your coil saturated and delivers up to 6000 puffs* before a replacement is required. Milky Strawberry is a smooth, dessert-inspired blend pairing sweet Strawberry with a rich, creamy milk base. The fruit notes provide a bright, summery introduction, while the dairy elements add a satisfying thickness and depth to the exhale. Inside the 2ml pod is an integrated 0.8ohm mesh coil, engineered to provide rapid, even heating for consistently dense vapour and highly accurate flavour reproduction. Fully compatible with the Viscore Neo battery device, this pack offers a reliable Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) vape that is simple to set up and effortless to maintain. How to Set Up Your Uwell Viscore Neo Pod: 1. Remove the 4ml refill container from the top of the packaging. 2. Remove the red silicone plug located on the top of the 2ml prefilled pod. 3. Insert the 4ml refill container into the 2ml prefilled pod smoothly until it is assembled in place. 4. Insert the fully assembled unit into your device. Note: We recommend waiting exactly five minutes after assembly to allow the e-liquid to fully saturate the mesh coil before taking your first draw. *Puff counts are approximate and dependent on the le5ngth of each draw. Total puffs may vary.
